coaching.headline: We won the fights and never pushed: kills 27 to 18 for us, towers 13 to 1 for them.
coaching.team: We won the fights and never pushed. Kills 27 to 18 for us, towers 13 to 1 and objective damage 25,798 to 85,018 for them; six fights won, one turned into anything. The opening was ours: Phase and GRIM.exe won 3-0 at Fangtooth at 7.9 and took it at 8, and Fangtooth again at 16. Then the map went while we fought two-man. Renna and Zarus lost 0-2 to Skylar and Lt. Belica at Mini Prime at 18.3, and the Genesis Core, an inner tower and an outer tower fell in the next 90 seconds. At 22 we won 4-1 while they took Fangtooth across the map. At 25.3 Renna and GRIM.exe lost 0-2 to Gideon and Skylar; Orb Prime and two inhibitors followed. Zarus died eight times, three before minute 10, on a jungle read that was ours on paper, and Countess did zero damage to objectives. Next game: after a won fight, all five walk to a tower before anyone goes back to lane.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The two-man fight at their Mini Prime at 18.3. Mini Prime had already gone to them at 18 with all five of us alive; then Renna and Zarus took Skylar and Lt. Belica two-on-two with GRIM.exe alive and ahead, lost 0-2, and the Genesis Core and two towers went inside 90 seconds. Every fight after that was played from behind on structures.
coaching.whatWorked: The duo lane early. Phase and GRIM.exe won the 3-0 at Fangtooth at 7.9 and took it at 8, and Phase killed Skylar three times across the game.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Phase did the support job. In on 16 of our 27 kills, 27,812 healing, the most in the game, 13 wards and no death before minute 10; three kills on Skylar and the fight at Fangtooth at 7.9, won 3-0, came through her. The one death, at 31.5 to Greystone, was in the fight at Primal Fangtooth, lost 0-2, that closed it.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: GRIM.exe won his lane and watched two-man fights lose the map. Nine kills, three deaths, 39,871 damage to heroes and Gideon killed three times. He was alive and ahead in lane for the fights at 18.3 and 31.2, both lost 0-2 by Renna and one partner; whether the wave let him leave is unknowable. The solo death at 15 to Skylar is his.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Countess was not in the game. Two kills, both on Greystone, two deaths, three assists, and zero damage to objectives in a game we lost 13 towers to 1. In on 5 of our 27 kills from a dive assassin whose job is the pick. An offlane that goes even has to become pressure somewhere else.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Zarus donated the jungle. Eight deaths, three before minute 10 including first blood to Khaimera at 3 caught alone, and three items, the fewest on our side. Two of the deaths, at 18.4 and 27, came right before lost towers.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Renna won mid and died in every two-man fight that lost the map. Eight kills, five deaths and 35,029 damage to heroes against Gideon, 2-5-4. Three of the deaths were two-man fights lost 0-2 between 18.3 and 31.2, each followed by a major or towers. No solo catch this time.

22.call: The fight at 22, won 4-1, and they still took Fangtooth; that is a trade only if a tower follows, and none did. Five alive after a won fight means push a lane instead of resetting.

7.9.call: The template we then abandoned: Phase and GRIM.exe won 3-0 at Fangtooth and took it at 8. A won fight walked straight into the objective. It happened once more all game, and that is the whole review.

31.2.call: Do not take Primal Fangtooth two-man with GRIM.exe alive and ahead in lane and Countess alive with no kill or death credited in it. Renna and Phase lost 0-2 to Skylar and Greystone, Primal Fangtooth went at 31 and the core followed. Down 13 towers to 1, the only fight is five-man.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Marshal, Enra's Blessing and Galaxy Greaves all done, with Windcaller and Vanguardian on top; nothing to teach here.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.eternal: The engine does not model support Eternals; the field runs Exarch on Phase, which puts attack speed on GRIM.exe every time the link heals him.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Off the core with Necrosis and Spear Of Desolation instead of Lightning Hawk and Dust Devil, and it produced 39,871 damage to heroes and Gideon killed three times; nothing to teach here.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.eternal: Vermis fits GRIM.exe because Pulsefire basics on one target are his whole trade, and the third consecutive hit is where the major pays.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.build: Noxia and Tainted Scepter on, Lifebinder skipped, no armor against three physical damage dealers; with two deaths the build was never the problem, and the zero objective damage was.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.eternal: Vesh with The Tenth Seal and Mind Rot suits a burst assassin whose Feast is the kill, adding a burn to Eventide and Blade Siphon and a stronger ultimate after level 10.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Three items in 32 minutes is the story before any order question. The skipped Tainted Blade is the anti-heal core item, and the jungler across from him was Khaimera, whose kit is healing; he killed Zarus twice, including first blood at 3.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.eternal: Thraex marks the target he last hit and Ferocity ramps attack speed the longer he fights, which is a Coliseum duelist's pattern, over the flat health Krix would have given an eight-death game.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: Entropy, Wraith Leggings and Overseer with Megacosm fourth; on core, nothing to teach here.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: Vesh adds a burn to every Soulfire and Mortal Coil hit, the right fit for a zone mage who chunks from range, with Mind Rot adding a slice of current health per hit against the Greystone frontline.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Lt. Belica. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 1 item of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Countess Feast (suppress 0.75s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Our damage is 4/5 magical — predictable; one magic-resist item answers most of it. Mix in a physical threat.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.combo: Energy Shield block → Displacement Blast → Assault Mode → GTFO lockon ult
ourKits.winCondition: out-trade with Pulsefire and the spell-shield, finish with GTFO
ourKits.playWith: peel so he can free-cast in Assault Mode
ourKits.playAgainst: bait Energy Shield, then commit; dodge GTFO's slow channel

ourKits.combo: Shadow Slip in → Eventide → Blade Siphon → Feast suppress ult, Haemorrhage true-damage
ourKits.winCondition: Feast-suppress a squishy and delete them with true-damage burst
ourKits.passive: two-ability hits apply a %max-HP true-damage bleed
ourKits.playWith: a team to clean up after her pick
ourKits.playAgainst: Feast is her whole engage — bait it / peel; she's fragile, punish the recast window

ourKits.combo: Evade in → Barricade block → Spear of Nyr (execute <20%) → Coliseum ult arena
ourKits.winCondition: trap a target in Coliseum and out-duel with stacked Gladiator
ourKits.playWith: a team that joins him inside the Coliseum
ourKits.playAgainst: don't fight him in his arena — disengage; burst through Barricade's window

ourKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
ourKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
ourKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
ourKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
ourKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

enemyKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
enemyKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
enemyKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Plasma Grenade → Hypercharge on-hit → Air Assault reposition → Atomiser ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Hypercharge and kite-shoot from Air Assault safety
enemyKits.passive: extra jump; kills cause corpse explosions
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline so she can free-fire airborne
enemyKits.playAgainst: CC her out of Air Assault; she's squishy on the ground

enemyKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
enemyKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

enemyKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
enemyKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
enemyKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
enemyKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

enemyKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
enemyKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
enemyKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal
